en.text:
While fully spun up and at full HP, gain an 80HP <arc/>Arc Shield over 1 second. Arc Shield recharges after 2 seconds of not taking damage.

<pvp Arc Shield Properties in PvP: />
• Provides immunity to precision damage
• 50% Damage Resist against Kinetic Damage
• 15% Damage Resistance against Non-Arc Elemental Damage
• If destroyed by <arc/>Arc Damage, it damages you and nearby allies for 130 damage in a ? meter radius

//DDC using red and blue text to indicate PvP/PvE behavior, but also using red and blue text to indicate Health versus Shields, lol. 
//Definitely does not charge at "Full Health" in PvE, you need full Shields too.
